question.problem: What is the average value of $g(x)=\sqrt[3]{x}$ on the interval $[1,8]?$
question.worked_solution:
Applying the average value formula, we find that the average value of the function is

$$
\begin{aligned}{g}_{\text{avg}} & =\frac{1}{b-a}\,{\int }_{a}^{b}f(x)\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{8-1}{\int }_{1}^{8}\sqrt[3]{x}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\frac{1}{7}(\frac{3}{4}{x}^{4/3})|}_{1}^{8} \\  & =\frac{1}{7}[(\frac{3}{4}\cdot {8}^{4/3})-(\frac{3}{4}\cdot {1}^{4/3})] \\  & =\frac{1}{7}[(\frac{3}{4}\cdot ({8}^{1/3})^{4})-\frac{3}{4}] \\  & =\frac{1}{7}[(\frac{3}{4}\cdot {2}^{4})-\frac{3}{4}] \\  & =\frac{1}{7}[(\frac{3}{4}\cdot 16)-\frac{3}{4}] \\  & =\frac{1}{7}(12-\frac{3}{4}) \\  & =\frac{45}{28}.\end{aligned}
$$
